blogs.title: Hello, LLMs! How Large Language Models Are Turning Tables into Intuition
blogs.description: This post walks readers through the core idea of FeatLLM in plain language. It explains why tabular data is traditionally hard for LLMs, how FeatLLM flips the script by using the model as a cooperative feature engineer, and what that means for real‑world applications like healthcare and finance.

blogs.title: Rule‑Based Features From ChatGPT: The Engine Behind Few‑Shot Tabular Success
blogs.description: Delve into the rule‑generation engine of FeatLLM. The blog explains the prompt structure, the two‑step reasoning strategy, and how rules are distilled into binary features that a tiny linear model can use—without needing to fine‑tune a large transformer for each prediction.

blogs.title: No Cost, No Latency: Why FeatLLM Is Perfect for Real‑Time Decision Systems
blogs.description: Explore the practical benefits highlighted in the paper: no per‑sample LLM calls at inference time, only a handful of API requests during setup, and a lightweight downstream model. We’ll compare runtimes with other LLM‑based tabular baselines and show why FeatLLM keeps latency low.

blogs.title: From Spurious Correlations to Robust Predictions: The Safety Net of Bagging + Inference Rules
blogs.description: This post focuses on how FeatLLM uses ensemble bagging to mitigate overfitting and noise in few‑shot regimes. It breaks down why bagging improves robustness against irrelevant columns and demonstrates the advantage with the heart‑disease dataset example.

blogs.title: Feeding a Language Model with Data Can Be Transparent – Feature Engineering Made Explainable
blogs.description: Discussing interpretability as an emerging feature area of FeatLLM. The article explains how rule‐based features provide insights into what the LLM considered important, how weights are tuned, and how this could help practitioners audit decisions in sensitive domains.
